name: vasantham-rewards
description: Vasantham Customer Loyalty & Rewards — backend, customer app, manager panel and admin panel

scripts.install-all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix customer-app/android-app install
scripts.dev:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-vasantham --only auth --ui "npm --prefix backend run start:firebase-emulator"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:hosting && firebase deploy --only hosting
